HIRE-PURCHASE AGREEMENT
(Machinery Finance)

Agreement No. AFL/HP/CBE/2026/00412

THIS HIRE-PURCHASE AGREEMENT ("Agreement") is made at Coimbatore on this 22nd day of May 2026

BETWEEN

ANANTHA FINSERV LIMITED, a non-banking financial company registered with the Reserve Bank of India, incorporated under the Companies Act, 2013 (CIN U65910TN2010PLC123456), having its registered office at 88, Race Course Road, Coimbatore 641018, Tamil Nadu, hereinafter called the "OWNER" or "FINANCIER" (which expression shall include its successors and assigns) of the ONE PART;

AND

KAVERI PACKAGING INDUSTRIES PRIVATE LIMITED, a company incorporated under the Companies Act, 2013 (CIN U21000TZ2015PTC123456), having its registered office and factory at Survey No. 91/2, SIDCO Industrial Estate, Kurichi, Coimbatore 641021, Tamil Nadu, acting through its Director Mr. Senthil Murugan Pillai, hereinafter called the "HIRER" (which expression shall include its successors and permitted assigns) of the OTHER PART.

WHEREAS the Hirer has requested the Financier to purchase and let on hire to the Hirer, with an option to purchase, the machinery described in the First Schedule (the "Machine"), and the Financier has agreed to do so on the terms and conditions set out below.

NOW IT IS AGREED AS FOLLOWS:

1. DEFINITIONS

1.1 "Machine" means the 5-axis CNC Vertical Machining Centre, Model VMC-850, Serial No. VMC850-2026-0338, together with all accessories, tools, attachments, replacements and additions, as described in the First Schedule.

1.2 "Cost of the Machine" means Rs 42,00,000/- (Rupees Forty-Two Lakh only), inclusive of Goods and Services Tax.

1.3 "Hire-Purchase Price" means the total sum of the Down Payment and all EMIs payable under this Agreement.

1.4 "EMI" means each monthly instalment of Rs 90,120/- (Rupees Ninety Thousand One Hundred and Twenty only) payable by the Hirer under Clause 3.

1.5 "Event of Default" has the meaning given in Clause 8.

2. HIRING AND TITLE

2.1 The Financier shall let on hire, and the Hirer shall take on hire, the Machine for a period of forty-eight (48) months commencing on 1 June 2026 and ending on 31 May 2030 (the "Hire Period").

2.2 The Machine shall at all times remain the exclusive property of the Financier until all sums payable under this Agreement have been paid in full. The Hirer shall have no right, title or interest in the Machine other than as a bailee. The Hirer shall affix a plate on the Machine stating "Property of Anantha Finserv Limited" and shall not remove it.

2.3 On payment of all sums payable hereunder, the Hirer shall be entitled to exercise the option to purchase the Machine for a nominal sum of Rs 1,000/-, upon which the Financier shall transfer title to the Hirer. The Financier shall not be bound to transfer title if any other amount is due from the Hirer to the Financier or its group companies under any other transaction.

3. PAYMENT TERMS

3.1 The Hirer has paid to the Financier a down payment of Rs 8,40,000/- (Rupees Eight Lakh Forty Thousand only), being twenty per cent (20%) of the Cost of the Machine (the "Down Payment"). The balance amount financed is Rs 33,60,000/- (Rupees Thirty-Three Lakh Sixty Thousand only).

3.2 The Hirer shall pay forty-eight (48) EMIs of Rs 90,120/- each, on or before the 5th day of each month, commencing from 5 June 2026, by way of electronic clearing mandate. The effective rate of interest is thirteen per cent (13%) per annum on reducing balance, as set out in the Repayment Schedule in the Second Schedule.

3.3 A processing fee of Rs 67,200/- (two per cent of the amount financed) plus GST, a documentation charge of Rs 15,000/- plus GST, and a stamping and legal charge of Rs 12,500/- have been deducted from or shall be paid by the Hirer. These charges are non-refundable.

3.4 All payments shall be made without set-off, counterclaim or deduction. The Hirer's obligation to pay the EMIs is absolute and unconditional, notwithstanding any defect in the Machine, its non-performance, or any dispute with the supplier.

4. SECURITY

4.1 As security for the due payment of all sums payable hereunder, the Hirer has delivered to the Financier five (5) cheques drawn on the Hirer's account with Coimbatore Urban Co-operative Bank, signed by the Hirer but with the amount, date and payee left blank (the "Security Cheques"). The Hirer irrevocably authorises the Financier to fill in the amount, date and name of the payee in any of the Security Cheques at any time and for any amount that the Financier considers due, and to present the cheque for encashment.

4.2 The Financier shall be entitled to present the Security Cheques notwithstanding any dispute between the Parties. If any Security Cheque is dishonoured, the Hirer shall be liable in addition to the consequences under Section 138 of the Negotiable Instruments Act, 1881, and shall pay a cheque dishonour charge of Rs 1,500/- per instance.

4.3 The Hirer shall furnish the personal guarantee of its Director Mr. Senthil Murugan Pillai and his spouse, whose liability shall be co-extensive with that of the Hirer, and shall not be discharged by any variation, indulgence or release granted by the Financier to the Hirer.

4.4 The Hirer has also executed an irrevocable power of attorney in favour of the Financier to enter the premises of the Hirer, take possession of the Machine and sell or otherwise dispose of it.

5. USE, MAINTENANCE AND INSURANCE

5.1 The Machine shall be installed at the factory of the Hirer at the address stated above and shall not be moved without the prior written consent of the Financier.

5.2 The Hirer shall keep the Machine in good working order and shall bear all costs of operation, repair, maintenance, taxes, licence fees and insurance. The risk of loss, theft, damage or destruction of the Machine shall pass to the Hirer on delivery. In the event of a total loss, the Hirer shall pay all remaining EMIs and any other sums payable immediately, without regard to any insurance claim.

5.3 The Hirer shall insure the Machine against all risks for its full replacement value through an insurer nominated by the Financier, with the Financier as the sole loss payee, and shall pay the premium to the Financier, who may retain any commission thereon.

6. PENAL INTEREST AND CHARGES

6.1 If any EMI or other sum is not paid on its due date, the Hirer shall pay to the Financier penal interest at the rate of thirty-six per cent (36%) per annum, compounded monthly, on the entire outstanding balance (and not merely on the overdue amount), from the due date until the date of actual payment, in addition to a late payment charge of Rs 2,500/- for each default.

6.2 The Hirer agrees that the rate of penal interest in Clause 6.1 is a genuine pre-estimate of the Financier's loss and is reasonable.

6.3 Any payment received shall be appropriated first towards penal interest, charges and costs, then interest, and last towards principal.

7. PREPAYMENT AND FORECLOSURE

7.1 The Hirer may prepay the outstanding amount only after the expiry of twelve (12) months from the date of this Agreement, and only on giving thirty (30) days' prior written notice.

7.2 On any prepayment or foreclosure, whether in full or in part and whether from the Hirer's own funds or otherwise, the Hirer shall pay a prepayment charge equal to five per cent (5%) of the principal outstanding, plus GST, in addition to all interest accrued and all other charges.

8. EVENTS OF DEFAULT

8.1 Each of the following is an Event of Default: (a) failure to pay any one (1) EMI on its due date; (b) any breach of this Agreement; (c) any default by the Hirer or its Directors under any other agreement with any lender; (d) any adverse change in the financial condition of the Hirer in the opinion of the Financier; (e) any change in the shareholding or Directors of the Hirer; or (f) the Financier considering itself insecure.

8.2 On the occurrence of an Event of Default, the entire balance of the Hire-Purchase Price, including all future EMIs without any rebate for the unexpired period, shall become immediately due and payable.

9. REPOSSESSION

9.1 On the occurrence of any Event of Default, including the failure to pay even a single EMI on its due date, the Financier shall be entitled, without notice to the Hirer and without recourse to any court, to enter upon the premises where the Machine is located, break open any lock, take possession of the Machine and remove it, and the Hirer hereby gives its irrevocable consent and licence for such entry and waives all claims for trespass, damage or loss of production arising from it.

9.2 The Financier may sell the Machine, by public auction or private treaty, at such price and to such person as it deems fit, including to its own affiliate, without notice to the Hirer. The proceeds shall be applied first to the costs of repossession, storage and sale, and then to the sums due. The Hirer shall remain liable for any shortfall, and the Financier shall not be bound to account for any surplus to the Hirer if the Hirer owes any amount to any group company of the Financier.

9.3 The Hirer shall have no right of redemption after repossession, and all EMIs paid up to the date of repossession shall be forfeited as hire charges for use of the Machine.

10. INDEMNITY

10.1 The Hirer shall indemnify the Financier against all claims, losses, damages, costs, taxes and expenses incurred in connection with the Machine, its use or its repossession, on a full indemnity basis, without any limit.

11. ASSIGNMENT

11.1 The Financier may assign, securitise or transfer this Agreement and the Security Cheques to any person without notice to the Hirer. The Hirer shall not assign or transfer its rights or part with possession of the Machine.

12. DISPUTE RESOLUTION AND GOVERNING LAW

12.1 This Agreement shall be governed by the laws of India.

12.2 All disputes shall be referred to a sole arbitrator to be appointed by the Financier, in accordance with the Arbitration and Conciliation Act, 1996. The seat of arbitration shall be Coimbatore. The Hirer agrees that the Financier's choice of arbitrator shall be final and binding.

12.3 The Financier may, notwithstanding Clause 12.2, institute proceedings in any court of competent jurisdiction for recovery of any amount or repossession of the Machine.

13. MISCELLANEOUS

13.1 The Financier's books of account shall be conclusive evidence of the amount due from the Hirer.

13.2 Any notice to the Hirer shall be deemed served on the third day after posting to the address stated above, whether or not received.

13.3 The Hirer authorises the Financier to disclose information about the Hirer and the Machine to credit information companies, group companies and any other person.

FIRST SCHEDULE - DESCRIPTION OF THE MACHINE

5-axis CNC Vertical Machining Centre, Model VMC-850, Serial No. VMC850-2026-0338, manufactured by Shivam Machine Tools Limited, with 12,000 rpm spindle, 24-tool ATC, Siemens controller, and chiller unit. Supplier invoice No. SMT/26-27/0194 dated 18 May 2026 for Rs 42,00,000/- inclusive of GST.

SECOND SCHEDULE - REPAYMENT SCHEDULE (SUMMARY)

Amount financed: Rs 33,60,000
Number of EMIs: 48
EMI: Rs 90,120
First EMI: 5 June 2026
Last EMI: 5 May 2030
Total of EMIs payable: Rs 43,25,760
Total interest component: Rs 9,65,760

IN WITNESS WHEREOF the Parties have executed this Agreement on the date first above written.
